title: docs(metadata): an uninstall UI calls unregisterPackageWithReport and shows each kept item
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DDZYUbJbnXUTqZoZ56k4czR)_
Fixes #32985

Clause-②: no — documentation comments only; no answer moves.
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：只改注释。`IMetadataService.unregisterPackage`（spec 合约）和 `MetadataManager.unregisterPackage` 写明：这个调用返回 `void`、没有 `force`，可能保留了部分条目却照常返回；卸载界面必须调用 `unregisterPackageWithReport` 并展示每个 `kept` 条目，否则卸载看起来成功，条目却仍在生效。
- 为什么改：#32985 的收尾。席位裁决（2026-11-14 21:41Z）：按 Elon 21:10Z「没有生产客户，修复里不做旧数据迁移」，原定保留 18.4.0 已绑定行的后续 PR（Q1 B）取消；只补这句文档。#33416 已合并（失败即保留的卸载保护）。
- 风险与回滚：零运行时变化；回滚 = revert。
- 先看：`packages/spec/src/contracts/metadata-service.ts` 的 `unregisterPackage` 注释。
- 需要你做的：无。

## What changes

- `packages/spec/src/contracts/metadata-service.ts`: `IMetadataService.unregisterPackage` jsdoc says the contract has no `force` and answers nothing, an implementation may keep items and still resolve, and an uninstall UI calls `MetadataManager.unregisterPackageWithReport` and shows each `kept` item.
- `packages/metadata/src/metadata-manager.ts`: the same note on `MetadataManager.unregisterPackage`, pointing at `unregisterPackageWithReport`.
- Changeset: `@objectstack/spec` and `@objectstack/metadata` patch.

## Closing the card

#33416 landed the fail-closed guard (`Refs #32985`). The seat's follow-up ruling Q1 B (keep rows an 18.4.0 boot bound to the host unless history shows them stamped since create) is retired under the maintainer's 2026-11-14 rule that fixes carry no legacy-data handling while there are no production customers; the seat noted it on the card. Q2 A (fail-closed stays) needs no change. The owed docs line is this PR.

## Verification

eslint on both files exit 0; comment-only diff (13 lines added, no code).
